title: Shift-register LED bar
prompt: Design a printed circuit board for an 8-LED indicator bar driven by a serial shift register: one shift register in a SOIC-16 package, eight LEDs, eight current-limiting resistors, and a 5-pin input header (VCC, GND, DATA, CLK, LATCH) — at least eighteen footprints total. Board outline at most 60mm × 25mm (a bar), two copper layers. Each shift-register output drives one LED through its own resistor to GND. Declare all nets, place components so the LEDs form a row, and route every net so its copper is fully connected — the parallel LED nets across a narrow board make routing discipline matter. The board must pass a design-rule check clean. Output a .vcad document containing the board as a PcbBoard node.
